heroTitle: A place for Haitians to stay connected.
heroBody: We’re building AyiNou for Haitians at home and abroad. It’s a place to keep in touch, share what’s happening in our communities, and work together.

communities.name: Communities at home and abroad
communities.description: We’re planning spaces to find people with ties to the same Haitian department or diaspora community.

conversations.name: Useful conversations
conversations.description: We want people to ask questions, share information with sources, and talk respectfully about what’s happening where they live.

projects.name: Projects we can work on together
projects.description: We want to make it easier to propose an idea, find people who can help, and work together on local projects.

missionBody: We believe in peaceful dialogue, trust grounded in evidence, and projects that deliver real results for communities. Everyone has a place at the table.
